desc: 现代简约组合办公桌模版：大字场景首屏、编号卖点系列、三段细节与规格服务收口
name: 现代简约组合办公桌款

shots.intent: 首屏以两行大字主张叠加真实办公场景完成 3 秒定调，让买家瞬间代入并愿意继续下滑。
shots.textZone: upper 45% copy zone: two-line heavy charcoal #2D2D2D headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 44pt with a hazy-blue #7C9CCF underline beneath the first line, three small dots divider, 18pt subtitle 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 一屏六宫格总结全部核心卖点，让买家 10 秒内扫完购买理由，形成记忆锚点。
shots.textZone: centered two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 40pt, thin grey divider, then a 2×3 icon grid with short labels 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 卖点之后先给三条品牌原则，用克制的版式建立值得托付的信任感。
shots.textZone: centered two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 40pt, three small dots divider, 18pt subhead 「{callout_1}」, then card titles 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 with one-line captions

shots.intent: Advantage 编号系列第 01 屏锁定板材环保卖点，建立整套详情的系列感阅读节奏。
shots.textZone: left column: small header 'Advantage Design' with large charcoal number '01' at top, thin vertical rule, two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt, 16pt subline 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: Advantage 02 右对齐换边，讲透置物功能梁与桌面收纳，节奏与 01 形成镜像。
shots.textZone: right-aligned column: large charcoal number '02' at top, small header 'Advantage Design', thin vertical rule, two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt, 16pt subline 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: Advantage 03 回到左对齐，聚焦桌面浮雕纹理与触感，为后续微距细节做铺垫。
shots.textZone: left column: small header 'Advantage Design' with large charcoal number '03' at top, thin vertical rule, two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt, 16pt subline 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: Advantage 04 右对齐收束系列，强调可拆装的结构工艺，回应搬运与二次安装顾虑。
shots.textZone: right-aligned column: large charcoal number '04' at top, small header 'Advantage Design', thin vertical rule, two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt, 16pt subline 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 左大图右大字的分栏把环保健康承诺可视化，英文大字承接国际感与品质心智。
shots.textZone: right column: oversized charcoal English word 'HEALTHY' in two lines, two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 28pt, a large '+' glyph, small letter-spaced micro-labels 'ATTITUDE NEW' and 'ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION'

shots.intent: 三段交替图文逐个证明接头、走线孔与垫片的工艺细节，逐一打消品质疑虑。
shots.textZone: each row: charcoal 20pt title 「{callout_1}」 / 「{callout_3}」 / 「{callout_5}」 with a thin short underline and a 14pt caption 「{callout_2}」 / 「{callout_4}」 / 「{callout_6}」 on the text side

shots.intent: 收口屏用两栏参数与服务条目回答能否定制、多久发货，消除下单前最后疑虑。
shots.textZone: centered two-line headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 36pt with a small letter-spaced English micro-caption, then a two-column spec grid of generic labels 材质/颜色/尺寸/是否定制/发货时效/售后 paired with short values 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_6}」

style.backgroundSystem: alternating flat pure-white #FFFFFF and light-grey #F0F0F0 infographic panels; the opening scene uses a plain light-grey wall #F0F0F0 with a white marble-vein floor; one small deep-green foliage sprig accents a corner of text panels
style.iconSystem: thin-line charcoal #2D2D2D icons with short labels; numbered advantage headers 01-04 with a thin vertical rule
style.lightingSystem: bright even diffused neutral 5500K light; soft contact shadows only on scene shots; flat shadowless light on infographic screens
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: cool minimal modern office-furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F0F0F0 flat panels, charcoal #2D2D2D text, one hazy-blue accent #7C9CCF, with small deep-green foliage accents in panel corners; neutral tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy two-line Chinese headlines in 「」, small three-dot dividers and letter-spaced English micro-labels; alternating flat grey and white infographic screens with thin vertical rules and numbered advantage headers; thin-line charcoal icons with short labels; product shown fully assembled at stable scale with a white body and dark trim edge; layouts composed edge to edge with type, rules and foliage balancing every panel; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented certifications or test data
style.presentationRules: product appears only in the opening scene and detail crops; white body with dark trim edge rendered consistently; desk fully assembled with its side storage cabinet; stable scale, props never cover the product
style.surfaceSystem: high-gloss white desktop with dark trim edge and white marble-vein floor in the scene; flat matte grey and white panels elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; heavy two-line Chinese headlines 36-48pt wrapped in 「」, 16-20pt subtitles, 10-14pt labels; small three-dot dividers; letter-spaced English micro-labels
